title: Beyond the Final Score: How Sports Became the New Investment Frontier
description: Discussion at the Sohn Investment Conference 2026 between investors Alexis Ohanian, Founder and General Partner, Seven Seven Six & Co-Founder and Former Executive Chairman, Reddit and Marc Lasry, Chairman, CEO and Co-Founder, Avenue Capital Group, moderated by Erik Serrano Berntsen, Chief Executive Officer, Stable. They discussed the transition of sports from trophy assets to institutional asset classes.
